evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive to discard prior knowledge asserts self-origination over what is retained — an autonomy move, not a value appeal.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Imperative to erase knowledge performs self-directed control over the cognitive record, the autonomy need as enacted command.
